description: Pause, resume, or cancel a People Search task. Free. pause: a queued search pauses at once; a running one finishes its current batch first (status pausing, then paused). A search paused for more than 7 days is cancelled. resume: continues a paused search where it stopped, with no new charge. cancel: stops the search for good; you pay only for the people it already delivered and the rest of the reservation is returned. People found so far stay readable for 30 days.
name: people-search-control
title: Control People Search
